CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: If the scene appears dark because there is no audio, turn this off.
CONTROLS.NAME: audio_brightness

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: More or less of the white swirling stars.
CONTROLS.NAME: starry_night

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Sends a ripple effect through the scene.
CONTROLS.NAME: ripple_in_spacetime

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Mix between seeing the colorful stars only, or the white shimmery dust only.
CONTROLS.NAME: star_dust_mix

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This lets you split the two types of stars based on brightness in the media.
CONTROLS.NAME: media_split_mix

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Alternate purple color palette. Good with Hue slider in meta controls.
CONTROLS.NAME: purple_stars

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turns off the bubbly blue nebula in the background.
CONTROLS.NAME: nebula_off

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn on if you want media to hard-mask the background (can be good with logos).
CONTROLS.NAME: media_mask

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This changes the stars into a mix of stars and galaxies, adding many more entities to the sky.
CONTROLS.NAME: billions_and_billions

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: This makes stars appear in geometric patterns. Patterns that can't have formed naturally...
CONTROLS.NAME: patterns_in_the_stars

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Occasionally a huge star can 'blow out' the image, and you can use this to reduce that occurrance. Keep it off to increase the number of stars generally, though.
CONTROLS.NAME: no_big_clumps

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Flattens the layers of stars down to a single surface. Interesting look with 'patterns in the stars' turned on as well.
CONTROLS.NAME: flatten_layers
